name: gatk_known_indels
description: The known indels file of the GATK resource bundle for hg38 (Homo_sapiens_assembly38.known_indels.vcf.gz), published by the Broad Institute. Known indels for base quality score recalibration.

hg38.naming: UCSC: chr1, chr2, chrX, as in the Broad's Homo_sapiens_assembly38.fasta. Fits that genome and a UCSC-named GRCh38 analysis set; not an Ensembl or NCBI-named one.
